coreProductDesc: FacturaGPT automates, analyzes, and translates financial data into actionable decisions in real time. It's the heart of the system, its competitive differentiator, and the main driver of margin and retention.
automateDesc: Set up automatic data flows with real-time monitoring. Execute actions without human intervention using conditional rules.
generativeDesc: Includes a conversational interface that allows you to query, analyze, and decide using natural language (voice or text).
gptAssistantDesc: Configurable by tone, context, and system connections. Adapts to internal knowledge and performs tasks autonomously.
connectionsWithAppsDesc: Native integration with ERPs, CRMs, banks, tax and payment platforms. Enables real-time flows and secure bidirectional synchronization.
operationalCollaboration: Operational Collaboration – Structured Input to the AI Engine
operationalCollaborationDesc1: Invite your team with specific access and run daily processes to generate the data that feeds the Core Product.
operationalCollaborationDesc2: Each action becomes a structured input that triggers automation and analysis.
transactionsDesc: Automated billing and payments. Reconciliations, approval workflows, alerts, and direct debits.
documentManagementDesc: Smart folders, OCR, digital signature, and workflows. Supports accounting, tax, legal, and HR document flows.
assetsManagementDesc: Inventory registration, amortization, technical parameters, discounts, and automated tracking.
financialCRMTitle: Financial CRM. Payment conditions, advanced segmentation, and supplier-client traceability. Compatible with bulk imports and external CRMs.
platformAndSupportDesc: Sustains the SaaS experience: security, scalability, and business continuity. Allows phased deployment, sector verticalization, and comprehensive support.
consultingAndSolutionsDesc: Tailored adaptation of processes, flows, and integrations. Customization without losing the SaaS model. Ideal for large accounts and complex sectors.
cloudInfrastructureDesc: Hosting in the EU, automatic backups, GDPR compliance, access control (SSO, MFA), full auditing, and secure deletion.
commercialSupportDesc: Post-sales support, strategic onboarding, retention, and upselling.
technicalSupportDesc: Maintenance, issue resolution, custom deployments, and guaranteed cloud scalability.
helpCenterDesc: Resources and articles, interactive support, help center, training content, FAQs...
